description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts consistently across a web application. It handles formatting of values as USD with dynamic precision, optional inclusion of credit suffixes, and special formatting for small or large numbers.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with options for precision, currency type, and credit suffix. Handles dynamic decimal placement based on value magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience wrapper to format USD with credits appended, using the main formatting function.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places, including thousand separators.
